title: Logix Smart Nasopharyngeal/Saliva Covid-19 PCR Prep (Station B)
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Arrange samples and reagents
steps.instruction: Place samples with pre‑added buffer into a NEST 96‑deepwell plate; load mastermix and controls into 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes positioned in the Opentrons 4 × 6 tube rack; follow the transfer order diagram provided.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input all required protocol parameters in the Opentrons interface as prompted.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload any needed .json labware files (e.g., NEST plates, tube rack).

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: In the Protocol tab of the Opentrons App, upload the .py protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map, placing all labware in the indicated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run tip‑rack, labware, and pipette calibrations using the OT App, following the support articles for calibration tips.

steps.title: Start the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the Opentrons App to execute the PCR preparation.
